text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's about to begin! The neighborhood 
association's Umamusume Wacky Sports 
Festival!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san, should I join in too?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love was chosen as a selected 
representative for Tracen Academy. Since 
she was chosen, she wanted to give it her 
all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them is an individual 
event... and there are four different 
kinds in total.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"The Obstacle Course, Individual 
Basketball, Individual Dodgeball, and the 
Eating Contest..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm not confident in any of them. 
Especially competitive eating... I'm quite 
a slow eater, you see...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I haven't really tried other sports 
much... Will I really be able to do this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There certainly are all kinds of worries. 
As I wondered whether everything would be 
all right...
No need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then we'll be your guides!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no matter what event it is, you have 
to aim for the top.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mar-chan will help out too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you have magic, nothing is 
impossible. You learned that in elementary 
school, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet, Aston Machan, and 
Sweep Tosho. It seems all four will be 
participating.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If we participate with someone, I think 
it'll ease our worries.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is. Look at you, Scarlet, 
saying something smart for once.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, who do you want to 
become friends with, Still-san? Is it 
Curren-chan after all?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If you insist that much, I wouldn't mind 
taking care of it for you!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A partner to enter with... Umm... Trainer, 
what should we do?
choice_data_list: Is it okay for me to decide?
Is it okay for me to decide?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Me, of course! Let's hit the court and 
pull off a super cool dunk together, eh?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an obstacle race with me, right? I'll 
clear any hurdle in a single bound!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to play dodgeball with 
Chan? *Tehe*, it's a landslide victory.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If it's a big eating contest, I'll help 
you out. I'll whip up dishes one after 
another with magic!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relying purely on a big appetite seems 
risky since Still in Love isn't great at 
it. Now, which one should I recommend?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do it! I'll teach ya plenty 
in real combat!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got the ball! Don't underestimate 
an Umamusume's jumping power. Time for a 
flashy slam dunk!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? There are three goals stacked 
vertically!? What is this height!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where's the ball? Did someone steal 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody has noticed... Stay calm... and 
take the shot."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Just imitating what I saw... Hiyah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A 3-point goal! The winner is Still in 
Love!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A three-pointer from all the way back 
there!? Damn, you're... freaking cool, 
Still!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much. Somehow, it worked 
out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Moving just like a shadow, Still in Love 
stole the ball and scored a brilliant 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: OK! Then let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I knew I was number one! No one can 
keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if Still is alright? I don't 
see her anywhere... Was she left behind?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, as long as they didn't fall, it's 
fine. Alright, crossing the finis—..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much... for pacing me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Eh!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal! Still in Love finishes in first! She 
slipped right out from behind at the very 
end!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, you... Don't tell me you were 
aiming for that!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, I was simply following behind hoping 
to learn a thing or two...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I tried copying what you did, 
Scarlett-san, and I was able to run really 
well. Thank... you so much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love was like a shadow. Running 
as if she were a mirror image, she swiftly 
snatched victory in the obstacle race.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's play dodgeball with 
Mar-chan. And leave behind a play that 
lasts for eternity.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone. Chan-me is right here, 
you know. Please don't forget meee.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If you want me to target you that badly... 
take that!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So standing out makes one a target. In 
that case...

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it vanished?! Where... where did it 
go...?!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Gwah!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Your back... was wide open. Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winner is—Still in Love!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... To conceal one's 
presence to this extent... Normally, that 
shouldn't even be possible, right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I can. And Universe-san, who shares a 
room with me, can as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truly a paranormal room. And so, Still in 
Love demonstrated her 'presence of having 
no presence' in dodgeball.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"That's what I like to hear! Leave the 
serving to me. You just eat, eat, and eat 
your heart out, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Here goes, magical meal serving! Paprika, 
Piprika, Bell Pepper!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now then, eat up, eat up! I'll keep the 
food coming at lightning speed! By 
controlling the staff with my magic, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're too slow! What are you 
doing savoring it like that? Hurry up...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, oh my? Everyone around Still is 
eating even slower than she is.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is this yakisoba? It's way too 
sweet, I can't eat it~.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Did you get the recipe wrong or 
something~? The sauce is all thick, 
sticky, and overly sweet.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, delicious... I feel like I could 
eat this forever. *munch... munch...*

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Still in Love! Slowly, yet 
without ever stopping, she ate an endless 
amount of yakisoba.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Did I cast a slow spell on everyone 
around me without even realizing it?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It seems so. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The attempt was a success! The true reason 
for victory was likely that Still in Love 
has a massive sweet tooth.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Hurry... Understood...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*chew*... *chew*... *chew*... *chew*... 
*chew*... *chew*... *chew*... *chew*... 
*chew*... *chew*... *chew*... *chew*...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why are you chewing your words so much~?! 
At this rate, there's no point in speeding 
up the tempo~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, Still in Love finished in 
last place. Her reckless challenge ended 
in failure.
